title: FTP server restarts on its own after being toggled and the app is dismissed from Recents

full_report.title: FTP server restarts on its own after being toggled and the app is dismissed from Recents
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user turns the FTP server on, turns it off, presses Back to leave the app, and dismisses the Files app from the Recents screen, the FTP server restarts on its own.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should not restart on its own.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open the Files app.
2. On the permission dialog, tap Allow.
3. Tap the Navigate up button.
4. Tap FTP server.
5. On the FTP server screen, tap the switch to turn the FTP server on.
6. Tap the switch to turn the FTP server off.
7. Press Back to leave the app.
8. In the Recents screen, dismiss the Files app.

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:
Buggy Behavior: the server restarts automatically
Triggering GUI Interaction: stops the FTP server and then closes the app
Triggering Screen Reference: FTP server screen
Correct Behavior: The FTP server should remain stopped
